title: movement
intro:
This component handles the movement in the soil.
  < component (Tertiary Tertiary ) >
    Tertiary: tertiary component (see chapter 89)
     Tertiary (that is, non-matrix) transport method.

Log Variables
    water failure level : integer
     The number of the last water transport model to fail. It is -1 if the first model
     succeded, and 0 if the first model failed but the second succeded.
    solute failure level : integer
     The number of the last solute transport model to fail. It is -1 if the first model
     succeded, and 0 if the first model failed but the second succeded.

sections.name: solute
sections.sig:
< solute (matrix solute matrix solute ...)

             (sink sorbed true)

attrs.name: matrix solute
attrs.doc:
Matrix solute transport models. Each model will be tried in turn, until one
     succeeds. If none succeeds, the simulation ends.

attrs.name: matrix solid
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘none’)
     Matrix solute transport model used for fully sorbed constituents.

attrs.name: sink sorbed
attrs.doc: Substract sink term from sorbed matter.

sections.name: rectangle
sections.desc:
A ‘solute’ model (see 56.1, page 307) build into Daisy.

  Two dimensional movement in a rectangular grid.
sections.sig:
< rectangle (Geometry Geometry )                ; Has partial value.
               (pipe outlet pipe outlet )         ; Default deep value.
               (Tertiary Tertiary )               ; Default none value.
               (matrix solute matrix solute ...) ; Has default value.
               (matrix water matrix water ...)    ; Has default value.
               (drainpoints)
               (heat heat )                       ; Default Mollerup value.
               ;; Shared parameters are described in section 56.1.
               (matrix solid matrix solid )       ; Default none value.
               (sink sorbed true) >

attrs.name: Geometry
attrs.doc:
Submodel (has partially specified default value)
        Discretization of the soil.

attrs.name: pipe outlet
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘deep’)
        Water table in drain pipe outlet.
        By default this will be considered deep enough to ensure free flow of water out
        of drains. If higher than the drain pipes, water may flow either way depending
        on the pressure in the soil.

attrs.name: matrix water
attrs.doc:
Component (has default value with length 3)
        (matrix_water Mollerup
                      "v+h"
                      const)
        Parameter description:
        Matrix water transport models. Each model will be tried in turn, until one
        succeeds. If none succeeds, the simulation ends.

attrs.name: drainpoints
attrs.doc:
Submodel (default: an empty sequence)
        Location of cells with drain pipes.
          <    z x    >
          – z : number [cm]
            Parameter
            Vertical position.
          – x : number [cm]
            Parameter
            Horizontal position.

sections.text:
A ‘solute’ model (see 56.1, page 307) build into Daisy.

  Two dimensional movement in a rectangular grid.
  < rectangle (Geometry Geometry )                ; Has partial value.
               (pipe outlet pipe outlet )         ; Default deep value.
               (Tertiary Tertiary )               ; Default none value.
               (matrix solute matrix solute ...) ; Has default value.
               (matrix water matrix water ...)    ; Has default value.
               (drainpoints)
               (heat heat )                       ; Default Mollerup value.
               ;; Shared parameters are described in section 56.1.
               (matrix solid matrix solid )       ; Default none value.
               (sink sorbed true) >

       Geometry: GeometryRect fixed component (see section 107.17)
        Submodel (has partially specified default value)
        Discretization of the soil.

       pipe outlet: depth component (see chapter 34)
        Component (default ‘deep’)
        Water table in drain pipe outlet.
        By default this will be considered deep enough to ensure free flow of water out
        of drains. If higher than the drain pipes, water may flow either way depending
        on the pressure in the soil.

       matrix water : uzrect component (see chapter 99) sequence
        Component (has default value with length 3)

        (matrix_water Mollerup
                      "v+h"
                      const)

        Parameter description:
        Matrix water transport models. Each model will be tried in turn, until one
        succeeds. If none succeeds, the simulation ends.

       drainpoints: submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
        Submodel (default: an empty sequence)
        Location of cells with drain pipes.
          <    z x    >

          – z : number [cm]
            Parameter
            Vertical position.
          – x : number [cm]
            Parameter
            Horizontal position.

       heat: heatrect component (see chapter 46)
        Component (default ‘Mollerup’)
        Heat transport model.
